one_line: OpenAI and Apple escalated their legal dispute with a countersuit, while Mistral released a 1-trillion-parameter model and Embo raised $110 million.

themes.title: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets
themes.text: OpenAI filed a countersuit in California against Apple, accusing the company of stealing trade secrets and coercing shared suppliers amid an ongoing dispute over former employees.

stories.headline: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets and supplier threats

themes.title: Mistral releases 1-trillion-parameter model
themes.text: Mistral released the open weights of Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), a 1-trillion-parameter multimodal model trained on European infrastructure.

stories.headline: Mistral releases weights for 1-trillion-parameter model Le Chonk

themes.title: Embo raises $110M for robot world models
themes.text: Robotics startup Embo emerged from stealth with a $110 million seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz to build world models trained on internet video and humanoid fleet experience.

stories.headline: Embo emerges from stealth with $110M seed led by a16z for robot world models
